name: pi-prompt-history
description: Pi extension that records the prompts you type to a local JSONL history and searches them with Ctrl+R or /history.

scripts.lint: biome check src test scripts spike/*.mjs spike/*.ts package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format: biome format --write src test scripts spike/*.mjs spike/*.ts package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.spike: node spike/sdk.mjs && python3 spike/tui.py && python3 spike/shortcut.py
